text: {"reason":"v1 has 20/28 false arbitrations (FPR 0.714) despite recall 1.0. Raise the change threshold from 0.15 to 0.45, above every listed false-positive magnitude (maximum 0.428), while retaining exposure and frozen-horizon guards. This targets all eight shown false positives without relying on confidence, which also fails for false rows at 0.83 and 0.91.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure) (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.45) (> inventory-exposure 500000) (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))))"}
